Here are two great value picks in our shaping leggings line, both priced the same so it really comes down to how you'll use them! ✨

SPANXshape® PowerPlay Full-Length Leggings | Very Black

Buttery-soft, matte fabric with gentle all-over shaping and mid-tummy support
Best for: everyday wear, low-to-medium workouts (yoga, Pilates, strength), and dressing up or down

SPANXshape® Booty Boost® Full-Length Leggings | SPANX® Red

Sleek, cool-touch fabric with 360 shaping that lifts and rounds the booty
Best for: medium-to-high intensity workouts, plus it has a hidden pocket and UPF 50+ for outdoor activities

If you're after an everyday, do-it-all piece, PowerPlay gives you the most versatility. If you want more visible shaping and workout-ready features, Booty Boost® is the stronger pick. How do you plan to wear yours most, gym or everyday?

Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?

Great question! Let's be real about it 🖤

SPANXshape® Scuba Legging ~$39

Sleek, polished legging with tummy shaping and a smooth, seam-free front
Great for work, travel, or dressing up/down - not built for intense workouts

SPANXshape® Booty Boost® Full-Length Leggings | SPANX® Red ~$98

Sweat-wicking, quick-drying performance fabric with 360 shaping, a booty-lifting design, hidden pocket, and UPF 50+
Built for real workouts and frequent wear

Honest take: if you mainly want a versatile, great-looking legging for everyday and casual dress-up moments, the Scuba Legging is absolutely fine and a smart budget pick. If you're doing regular workouts and want shaping plus performance features you'll actually use, the Booty Boost® is worth the extra.

How often do you realistically work out versus just wearing leggings as everyday pants? That'll help me nudge you the right way!
